EXPERIMENTS & WHAT’S NEXT

Good ideas. Questionable ideas.
Only one way to find out.

A home for the next experiments, unfinished obsessions, and ideas that probably need adult supervision.

In the works

BUILDING

The ideas that escaped the notebook.

Browser Football

A retro football prototype with play calls, formations, diving tackles, and interceptions in a 4:3 browser field. Chasing that “one more drive” feeling with no emulator required.

SignalField

A Windows console dashboard tracking nearby Wi-Fi networks, signal strength, latency, jitter, and packet loss. Turns “the internet feels weird” into graphs, history, and actual evidence.

FiveBucketTrader

A paper-trading dashboard that divides a portfolio into cash and four stock buckets, with configurable triggers and trade history. A sandbox for finding out what happens when a spreadsheet gets trading privileges.

Backlog

MAYBE SOMEDAY

Too interesting to delete. Too early to promise.

Garage Touchdown

A live-touchdown trigger that would light up the garage through a smart plug and home automation. Because apparently yelling at the TV needs an exterior lighting package.

BBS Door Game Ports

Browser recreations of old-school BBS door-game mechanics, starting with a GutterBowl-inspired bowling experiment. Bringing the dial-up rabbit hole back, minus the modem noises.

Final Round Golf

A text-only console golf concept with seeded 18-hole courses, timing-based swings, and a final-day leaderboard to chase. All the pressure of a tournament comeback, rendered in colored text.

Experiments, not release promises. Plans can get weird.
